answer: Each agent must visit a booth at the jetty beside the lagoon, where a fixed camera records the visit. A bonded notary checks a government ID from a database issuing one number per person against live video, stamps a violet mark, and the ledger binds one key per ID, slashing deposit on duplicates. The notary and camera are paid from that deposit. Sybils need extra humans or stolen IDs, so n identities pay nC for reward nR, profitable only while R>C. Notary collusion or forged IDs remain the weakness.
